source_lattice_proof.tail_argument: K has max coordinate sqrt2<3/2. If Bz lies in2K then ||z||infinity<3||B^-1||infinity=tail_upper, so every possibly overlapping integer word is in the enumerated cube. Every nonzero such word has the listed exact strict separating face.

Retain a realized directed face separator for every pair, close all24 common host walls and continue only separators exposed by the actual preceding complete packing.
construction.native_decoder: Multiply exact rational centers by100000001/100000000 and store binary64 numeric values; use identity quaternions. The outward host scale is idealS*(1+1e-8)+1e-8. All native numeric inputs are checked as exact rationals.
